_comment: S (bandit) + BLE rule families, which .ruff.toml's select omits. Ratchet only: lower this as findings are fixed, never raise it without justification in review. See tools/check_lint_budget.py. Raised 46->56 (2026-08-14): Week 2 harness expansion added hooks (pre_push.py, security_post.py, quality_gate.py) and garden tooling with subprocess calls -- all reviewed, pinned argv, no shell=True. Raised 56->57 (2026-08-14): tools/session_persistence.py (S608: f-string SQL query) -- safe, WHERE clause built from hardcoded strings only, all user inputs use ? placeholders. Raised 57->60 (2026-09-04): tools/benchmark_executors.py (3x S603: subprocess calls to opencode CLI with controlled task input, shlex-quoted args, shell=False) -- benchmark tooling for executor comparison. Raised 60->75 (2026-09-10): ported mcp-builder skill's scripts/evaluation.py (S314 xml.etree parse of local eval files, 2x BLE001 broad except around file/parse errors) -- vendored from Anthropic's official skills repo, mirrored 5x (.kilo, .claude, .copilot, .gemini, .opencode); each copy adds 3 findings (15 total). It parses evaluation XML the user authors locally, not untrusted network input. Lowered 75->72 (2026-09-10): removed the duplicate .opencode/skills mirror (OpenCode now loads .claude/skills natively), dropping one of the five evaluation.py copies (-3 findings). Raised 72->74 (2026-09-14): tools/codex_session.py (S607: `git diff --name-only` subprocess with a partial executable path -- argv is pinned and the command is a fixed literal, same accepted pattern as the other git calls in tools/) and tools/codex_verify.py (S603: `subprocess.run` iterating a module-level COMMANDS list of this repo's own gate scripts -- fixed argv, shell=False, no user input). Lowered 74->45 (2026-10-06): (a) excluded tools/test_*.py from S/BLE via .ruff.toml per-file-ignores -- tests invoke sys.executable/node/git with fixed argv and shell=False, so the bandit S-checks are noise there (26 findings); (b) moved 3 subprocess noqa comments from the `subprocess.run(` line to the argv line, where ruff actually reports S607, so the intended suppression takes effect (security_scan.py, garden.py, check_lint_budget.py; 3 findings). Lowered 45->43 (2026-10-23): two S607 findings disappeared when tools/coverage_gate.py switched to sys.executable. The remaining 43 are all reviewed accepted patterns (pinned argv, shell=False, no user input).
